goal: Generate benchmark blocks at runtime instead of relying on an outdated 2016 pre-SegWit binary fixture
Let developers benchmark modern witness and Taproot script mixes while shedding repository binary bloat
agreement: Strong support for modernizing benchmark coverage and removing static binary fixtures
Enables testing against modern and realistic block workloads (yuvicc, Raimo33, hodlinator)
Reduces repository bloat and avoids adding new static blocks over time (0xB10C)
Resolved concern: block generation exceeding size limits addressed with multi-seed tests (hodlinator)

categories.name: tests
why: P2 because it replaces outdated pre-SegWit fixtures with flexible, modern transaction mixes
Expands benchmark coverage to SegWit and Taproot across validation and deserialization benchmarks
Removes roughly 1 MB of static binary fixture data from the repository
